question: Sports Journalists' Federation of India (SJFI) Para-athlete Woman of the Year Award 2021 winner Avani Lekhara plays which sport?
solution:
The correct answer is** __Shooting__**__.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Sports Journalists' Federation of India (SJFI) Para-athlete Woman of the Year Award 2021 winner Avani Lekhara plays **Shooting**.
 
• **SJFI **Medal is the **highest honour of SJFI.**
 
• **SJFI **was **born **in **Calcutta**.
 
• It was on **27 February 1976 **that the **Sports Journalists Federation of India (SJFI) **was formed at the **Eden Gardens**, **Calcutta**, during the **inaugural year **of the **J.K. Bose Cricket Tournament**. The cream of sports scribes from **Delhi, Calcutta, and Bombay **was involved in **forming the federation.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• There are other **national sports **awards like:

 
 
• Khel Ratna Award. 
 
• Arjuna Award. 
 
• Dronacharya Award. 
 
• Major Dhyan Chand Award.
 
• Maulana Abul Kalam Azad Trophy. 
 
• Rashtriya Khel Protsahan Puruskar.
 
• Tenzing Norgay National Adventure Award.
